title.zh: 卷297 列傳八十四 查郎阿 傅尔丹 马尔赛 李杕 庆复 李质粹 张广泗
title.en: Volume 297 Biographies 84: Cha Langa, Fu Erdan, Ma Ersai, Li Di, Qing Fu, Li Zhicui, Zhang Guangsi
title.raw: 卷297 列傳八十四 查郎阿 傅尔丹 马尔赛 李杕 庆复 李质粹 张广泗

sentences.zh: 列傳八十四

translations.literal: Biographies 84
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 84

sentences.zh: 查郎阿傅爾丹馬爾賽李杕慶復李質粹張廣泗

translations.literal: Cha Lang'a, Fu Erdan, Ma Ersai, Li Di, Qing Fu, Li Zhicui, Zhang Guangsi
translations.idiomatic: Cha Lang'a; Fu Erdan; Ma Ersai; Li Di; Qing Fu; Li Zhicui; Zhang Guangsi

sentences.zh: 查郎阿，字松莊，納喇氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Cha Lang'a, courtesy name Songzhuang, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Cha Lang'a, whose courtesy name was Songzhuang, belonged to the Nara clan and served as a Manchu bannerman of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 曾祖章泰，以軍功授拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Zhangtai was awarded the jasak darhan rank for military merit.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Zhangtai received the jasak darhan hereditary rank for distinguished service in war.

sentences.zh: 祖查爾海，復以軍功進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: His grandfather Cha'erhai was further promoted to first-class adaha gusa rank for military merit.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Cha'erhai was later raised to first-class adaha gusa rank, again for military merit.

sentences.zh: 父色思特，死烏闌布通之戰。

translations.literal: His father Sesite died in the battle at Ulan Butong.
translations.idiomatic: His father Sesite was killed at the battle of Ulan Butong.

sentences.zh: 查郎阿襲世職，兼佐領，遷參領。

translations.literal: Cha Lang'a inherited the hereditary office, also served as assistant banner commander, and was promoted to company commander.
translations.idiomatic: Cha Lang'a succeeded to the family post, held an assistant command in the banner, and was later promoted to company commander.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，授吏部郎中。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Yongzheng reign he was appointed a director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he was made a director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二年，超擢侍郎，署鑲黃旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: In the second year he was promoted by exception to vice minister and acted as commandant-general of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was leapfrogged to vice minister and served concurrently as commandant-general of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷左都御史，仍治吏部事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to left censor-in-chief while still administering Ministry of Personnel affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became left censor-in-chief but continued to oversee the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 是歲冬，西藏噶布倫阿爾布巴等為亂，戕總理藏務貝子康濟鼐，扎薩克台吉頗羅鼐馳聞，上命查郎阿偕副都統邁祿率兵入藏。

translations.literal: That winter the Tibetan garpon Arbab and others rebelled and killed Kangjidai, the beile in charge of Tibetan affairs; the jasak taiji Poluonai rushed word of it, and the emperor ordered Cha Lang'a together with Vice President of the Banner Corps Mailu to lead troops into Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Tibetan garpons Arbab and his confederates rose in revolt and murdered Kangjidai, the prince who directed Tibetan affairs. The jasak taiji Poluonai sent urgent word to court, and the emperor ordered Cha Lang'a, together with Vice President Mailu of the Banner Corps, to march into Tibet.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted to minister.

sentences.zh: 秋，師至藏，駐藏副都統馬喇等已擒阿爾布巴，即按誅之，並殲其餘黨。

translations.literal: In autumn the army reached Tibet; the garrison vice president Mala and others had already captured Arbab, who was immediately executed according to law, and the rest of his faction was annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Tibet that autumn, the garrison vice president Mala and his colleagues had already seized Arbab. He was promptly put to death under due process, and the remaining rebels were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 查郎阿奏移達賴喇嘛暫居里塘，留兵二千交駐藏大臣調遣；

translations.literal: Cha Lang'a memorialized to move the Dalai Lama temporarily to Litang and leave two thousand troops for the resident commissioner in Tibet to deploy;
translations.idiomatic: Cha Lang'a proposed moving the Dalai Lama temporarily to Litang and leaving two thousand troops at the disposal of the resident commissioner in Tibet;

sentences.zh: 又奏請以頗羅鼐總理後藏，而前藏達賴喇嘛未還，畢昭新授噶布倫，慮未妥協，並令頗羅鼐兼領：皆從之。

translations.literal: he also memorialized to put Poluonai in charge of rear Tibet; because the Dalai Lama had not yet returned to front Tibet and Bizhao had newly been appointed garpon, he feared matters would not be settled, and asked that Poluonai hold both posts concurrently—all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: he also asked that Poluonai oversee rear Tibet. With the Dalai Lama still absent from Lhasa and Bizhao newly appointed garpon, he worried that affairs would not run smoothly and urged that Poluonai hold both responsibilities. The court approved every point.

sentences.zh: 七年，命查郎阿至西安，留佐川陝總督岳鍾琪，專理軍需。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to Xi'an to assist Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general Yue Zhongqi in managing military supplies exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was sent to Xi'an to assist the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general Yue Zhongqi, devoting himself solely to military logistics.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪授大將軍，出師，令署川陝總督兼西安將軍，加太子少保。

translations.literal: Zhongqi was appointed grand general and took the field; Cha Lang'a was ordered to act as Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general and Xi'an general concurrently, with the added title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi received the grand general's seal and marched out; Cha Lang'a was ordered to serve concurrently as Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general and Xi'an general and was given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 八年，命往肅州專理軍需。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered to go to Suzhou to manage military supplies exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was sent to Suzhou to take charge of military supplies alone.

sentences.zh: 九年，析置四川、陝西兩總督，查郎阿改署陝西總督。

translations.literal: In the ninth year separate governor-generalships were created for Sichuan and Shaanxi; Cha Lang'a was reassigned to act as Shaanxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Sichuan and Shaanxi were split into separate governor-general jurisdictions, and Cha Lang'a was reassigned as acting governor-general of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十年，召鍾琪還京師，以查郎阿署寧遠大將軍，命大學士鄂爾泰馳驛往肅州授方略，並賜白金萬。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Zhongqi was recalled to the capital; Cha Lang'a was appointed acting Ningyuan grand general; the emperor ordered Grand Secretary Ortai to ride post-haste to Suzhou to convey strategy and bestowed ten thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Zhongqi was recalled to the capital and Cha Lang'a was made acting Ningyuan grand general. Grand Secretary Ortai was dispatched post-haste to Suzhou to deliver the battle plan, and Cha Lang'a was granted ten thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 十一年，疏劾副將紀成斌防廋集、總兵張元佐防無克克嶺，敵入掠糧車，漫無偵察。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he memorialized impeaching brigade general Ji Chengbin for defending Shouji and major general Zhang Yuanzuo for defending Wukekeling: the enemy entered and plundered grain convoys with utterly no reconnaissance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he impeached Brigade General Ji Chengbin, who held Shouji, and Major General Zhang Yuanzuo, who held Wukekeling, because enemy raiders had overrun their sectors, looted supply trains, and met no effective scouting.

sentences.zh: 上命斬成斌，元佐坐降調。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Chengbin beheaded; Yuanzuo was demoted and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Chengbin executed; Yuanzuo was demoted and transferred.

sentences.zh: 又劾總兵曹勷防哈密，縱賊妄報，上命斬勷。

translations.literal: He also impeached major general Cao Qing for defending Hami and allowing the enemy to file false reports; the emperor ordered Qing beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: He also impeached Major General Cao Qing at Hami for letting the enemy circulate false intelligence; the emperor ordered Qing beheaded as well.

sentences.zh: 又劾副都統阿克山、觀音保牧馬多死，玩悮軍事，下部議當斬。

translations.literal: He further impeached vice presidents Ake Shan and Guanyinbao because many horses died under their herding and they neglected military duties; the ministries deliberated that they should be executed.
translations.idiomatic: He further charged Vice Presidents Ake Shan and Guanyinbao with losing large numbers of horses under their care and treating military duty lightly; the ministries recommended the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 查郎阿復奏阿克山、觀音保所部兵久居南方，不知牧馬法，視退縮竊換者有間，請暫免死，今於通衢荷校，遍示諸軍。

translations.literal: Cha Lang'a memorialized again that the troops under Ake Shan and Guanyinbao had long dwelt in the south and did not know horse-herding methods, differing from those who shrank back and secretly substituted inferior animals; he asked temporary exemption from death and that they now be placed in the cangue on the public highway to be shown to all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Cha Lang'a followed with a plea that Ake Shan and Guanyinbao be spared for the moment: their men had long served in the south and were unfamiliar with frontier horse-keeping, unlike soldiers who deliberately shirked duty or swapped out mounts. He asked that they be placed in the cangue on the main road as a warning to every unit.

sentences.zh: 十三年，噶爾丹策淩乞和，命查郎阿撤兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Galdan Tseren sued for peace and the emperor ordered Cha Lang'a to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Galdan Tseren sought peace, and the emperor ordered Cha Lang'a to withdraw his forces.

sentences.zh: 奏請留兵戍哈密及三堡沙棗爾、塔勒納沁諸城，並於南山大坂、無克克嶺、塔勒納沁河源分設斥堠，又奏於安西及赤金、靖逆、柳溝、布隆吉爾、橋灣五處分兵駐防，部議如所請。

translations.literal: He memorialized to leave troops garrisoning Hami and the three forts Shaza'er, Talenaxin, and other cities, and to set outposts separately at Nanshan Daban, Wukekeling, and the headwaters of the Talenaxin River; he also memorialized to divide troops for garrison at Anxi and at Chijin, Jingni, Liugou, Bulongji'er, and Qiaowan in five places—the ministries approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to keep garrisons at Hami and at the three forts of Shaza'er, Talenaxin, and related posts, with lookout stations on Nanshan Pass, Wukekeling, and the Talenaxin headwaters. He also proposed dividing forces among Anxi, Chijin, Jingni, Liugou, Bulongji'er, and Qiaowan. The ministries approved his plan in full.

sentences.zh: 授文華殿大學士，兼兵部尚書，仍改陝西總督為川陝總督。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall and concurrently Minister of War, and the Shaanxi governor-generalship was again changed to Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall and concurrent Minister of War, and his jurisdiction was restored to the combined Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-generalship.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，疏言甘肅地瘠，請撥陝西倉糧預籌協濟，命會巡撫劉於義確議。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Qianlong reign he memorialized that Gansu land was poor and asked to allocate Shaanxi granary grain in advance for coordinated relief; he was ordered to confer with provincial governor Liu Yuyi for a definite plan.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 he reported that Gansu was impoverished and asked to draw grain in advance from Shaanxi granaries for coordinated relief. The court told him to work out the details with Provincial Governor Liu Yuyi.

sentences.zh: 尋請撥陝西倉糧八萬石運貯慶陽、涇州、靜寧、固原諸處，從之。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he asked to allocate eighty thousand shi of Shaanxi granary grain for transport and storage at Qingyang, Jingzhou, Jingning, Guyuan, and other places; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He soon secured approval to move eighty thousand shi of Shaanxi grain into storehouses at Qingyang, Jingzhou, Jingning, Guyuan, and neighboring points.

sentences.zh: 疏劾甘肅巡撫許容匿災營私，上命奪容官逮治。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching Gansu provincial governor Xu Rong for concealing disasters and pursuing private gain; the emperor ordered Rong stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached the Gansu governor Xu Rong for covering up famine and lining his own pockets. The emperor stripped Rong of rank and ordered him taken into custody.

sentences.zh: 秋，入覲，諭速回任。

translations.literal: In autumn he came to audience; he was instructed to return quickly to his post.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he came to audience and was told to return to his post without delay.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「軍中馬駝被竊，當責大將軍償補。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "When army horses and camels are stolen, the grand general should be held responsible for compensation.
translations.idiomatic: He reported: "When army horses or camels are stolen, the grand general should make restitution.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年以前，岳鍾琪任之；

translations.literal: Before the tenth year of Yongzheng, Yue Zhongqi bore that responsibility;
translations.idiomatic: Before Yongzheng 10 that duty fell to Yue Zhongqi;

sentences.zh: 十一年，臣任之。

translations.literal: in the eleventh year your servant bore it.
translations.idiomatic: from the eleventh year onward it has been mine.

sentences.zh: 惟鄂爾多斯牧廠所失及歷年馬駝多斃，請免追償。」

translations.literal: Only for losses at the Ordos pasture stations and for the many horses and camels that died over the years, I ask to be exempted from pursuit of compensation."
translations.idiomatic: I ask only that losses from the Ordos pasture depots and the many animals that died over the years not be charged back to me."

sentences.zh: 上許之。

translations.literal: The emperor granted this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted the request.

sentences.zh: 三年，奏劾肅州道黃文煒、軍需道沈青崖等侵帑，並及於義徇庇，遣左都御史馬爾泰會鞫論罪。

translations.literal: In the third year he memorialized impeaching Suzhou circuit intendant Huang Wenwei, military supply circuit intendant Shen Qingya, and others for embezzling funds, also implicating Liu Yuyi for favoritism; the left censor-in-chief Maertai was dispatched to join in investigation and fix guilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he charged Suzhou Circuit Intendant Huang Wenwei, Military Supply Intendant Shen Qingya, and others with embezzlement, and implicated Liu Yuyi for shielding them. Left Censor-in-Chief Maertai was sent to conduct a joint inquiry and fix penalties.

sentences.zh: 章嘉呼圖克圖請以里塘、巴塘畀達賴喇嘛，查郎阿奏：「聖祖時克西藏，收里塘、巴塘內屬。

translations.literal: The Changkya Khutukhtu asked to give Litang and Batang to the Dalai Lama; Cha Lang'a memorialized: "When the Sacred Ancestor conquered Tibet, Litang and Batang were brought within the empire.
translations.idiomatic: The Changkya Khutukhtu asked that Litang and Batang be handed to the Dalai Lama. Cha Lang'a replied: "When the Kangxi emperor conquered Tibet, Litang and Batang were incorporated into the empire.

sentences.zh: 章嘉呼圖克圖以日用不敷為辭，藏中大小廟千餘，常住喇嘛四十餘萬，需用良鉅。

translations.literal: The Changkya Khutukhtu pleaded insufficient daily expenses; in Tibet there are more than a thousand large and small temples and more than four hundred thousand resident lamas, with very great needs.
translations.idiomatic: The Changkya Khutukhtu pleaded that daily expenses were inadequate. Tibet has more than a thousand temples large and small and over four hundred thousand resident lamas, whose needs are enormous.

sentences.zh: 請視里塘、巴塘諸地每歲徵收數目，以打箭爐商稅撥予達賴喇嘛，地仍內屬如故。」

translations.literal: Please consider the annual tax receipts from Litang, Batang, and other places and allocate Dartsedo merchant taxes to the Dalai Lama, while the land remains within the empire as before."
translations.idiomatic: Let the annual revenue from Litang, Batang, and the like be assessed, and assign the Dartsedo merchant tax to the Dalai Lama while the territories remain imperial possessions as before."

sentences.zh: 上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended and approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 寧夏地震，查郎阿馳往賑撫。

translations.literal: When Ningxia suffered an earthquake, Cha Lang'a hurried there to relieve and comfort the people.
translations.idiomatic: When an earthquake struck Ningxia, Cha Lang'a rushed there to organize relief.

sentences.zh: 五年，命還京入閣治事，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered back to the capital to conduct affairs in the Grand Council, with the added title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was recalled to the capital to serve in the Grand Council and was given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 六年，命與侍郎阿里袞清察黑龍江、吉林烏喇開墾地畝。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was ordered together with Vice Minister Aligun to inspect and clear the acreage of newly opened land in Heilongjiang and Jilin Wula.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he and Vice Minister Aligun were sent to audit newly opened farmland in Heilongjiang and Jilin Wula.

sentences.zh: 十二年，以衰病，命致仕。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, on account of infirmity and illness, he was ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, worn by age and illness, he was permitted to retire.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，費英東曾孫，倭黑子也。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, a great-grandson of Fiyanggū and son of Wohei.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, a great-grandson of the founding minister Fiyanggū and the son of Wohei.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十年，襲三等公，兼佐領，授散秩大臣。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Kangxi he inherited the third-rank duke's title, also served as assistant banner commander, and was appointed a minister without specific portfolio.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 20 he succeeded to the third-rank dukedom, held an assistant command in the banner, and was appointed a minister without portfolio.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，上西巡，駐蹕祁縣鄭家莊，於行宮前閱太原城守兵騎射。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year the emperor made a western tour and halted at Zhengjiazhuang in Qi County; before the traveling palace he reviewed the mounted archery of Taiyuan city garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year, during an imperial tour of the west, the court halted at Zhengjiazhuang in Qi County, where the emperor reviewed mounted archery by the Taiyuan garrison before the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 有卒馬驚逸近禦仗，傅爾丹直前勒止之，捽其人下。

translations.literal: A soldier's horse bolted in alarm near the imperial guard; Fu Erdan went straight forward, reined it in, and dragged the man down.
translations.idiomatic: When a trooper's mount panicked near the imperial escort, Fu Erdan rushed forward, checked the horse, and pulled the rider from the saddle.

sentences.zh: 上悅，諭獎傅爾丹，賜貂皮褂。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased, issued commendation to Fu Erdan, and bestowed a sable fur jacket.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased, praised Fu Erdan publicly, and granted him a sable jacket.

sentences.zh: 尋授正白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed commandant-general of the Mongol Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed commandant-general of the Mongol Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he was appointed chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year he became chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，以託疾未入直，罷領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, for claiming illness and failing to attend duty, he was dismissed from chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year he was removed as chief bodyguard commandant for feigning illness and absenting himself from duty.

sentences.zh: 命率土默特兵千赴烏蘭固木等處屯田。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead one thousand Tümed troops to Ulan Gum and other places for military farming.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to lead a thousand Tümed troops to Ulan Gum and neighboring posts to open military colonies.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，复授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he was again appointed chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year he was restored as chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 師討噶爾丹，授富寧安靖逆將軍，出西路；

translations.literal: When the army campaigned against Galdan, Funing'an was appointed Pacification General of the West and marched by the western route;
translations.idiomatic: When troops marched against Galdan, Funing'an was made Pacification General of the West and took the western route;

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹振武將軍，出北路：駐軍阿爾泰。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan was made Martial Valor General and marched by the northern route, encamping the army at Altai.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan was named Martial Valor General and took the northern route, encamping at Altai.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，疏請與富寧安分路進兵，諭定師期。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he memorialized to advance by separate routes with Funing'an; the emperor ordered the campaign schedule fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-seventh year he proposed advancing on separate axes with Funing'an, and the emperor set the date for the general advance.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹請與征西將軍祁里德將萬二千人，以七月出布魯爾，直抵額爾齊斯河。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan asked to join Western Campaign General Qilide in leading twelve thousand men to set out from Burul in the seventh month and reach the Irtysh River directly.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan asked to join Western Campaign General Qilide with twelve thousand men, march from Burul in the seventh month, and strike straight for the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 會策妄阿喇布坦使來乞和，令暫停進取，繕兵防守。

translations.literal: When Tsewang Araptan's envoy came suing for peace, they were ordered temporarily to halt the advance and repair the army for defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Tsewang Araptan sent envoys to sue for peace, the court ordered a pause in the advance and told the armies to fortify their positions.

sentences.zh: 上欲於烏蘭固木、科布多築城衛喀爾喀游牧，命傅爾丹相度具奏。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to build walled cities at Ulan Gum and Kobdo to protect Khalkha pastoralists and ordered Fu Erdan to survey the sites and memorialize in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to build fortified towns at Ulan Gum and Kobdo to shield Khalkha herders and ordered Fu Erdan to survey the ground and report.

sentences.zh: 五十八年春，傅爾丹疏請築城鄂勒齊圖郭勒，上以鄂勒齊圖郭勒距師遠，命更於科布多築城。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifty-eighth year Fu Erdan memorialized to build a city at Ölöktu Gol; the emperor said Ölöktu Gol was too far from the army and ordered instead to build at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifty-eighth year Fu Erdan proposed building at Ölöktu Gol, but the emperor judged the site too remote from the main force and directed construction at Kobdo instead.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹复疏言：「科布多阻大河，材木難致。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan memorialized again: "Kobdo is blocked by a great river and timber is hard to obtain.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan replied: "Kobdo lies beyond a major river, and timber is hard to bring in.

sentences.zh: 請築城察罕廋爾，距鄂勒齊圖郭勒千里，中設十一站。」

translations.literal: I ask to build the city at Chaghan Shou'er, a thousand li from Ölöktu Gol, with eleven relay stations between."
translations.idiomatic: I ask to build at Chaghan Shou'er, a thousand li from Ölöktu Gol, with eleven relay stations between."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，將八千人自布拉罕進次格爾額爾格，準噶爾兵潰，擊斬二百餘級，擒宰桑等百餘，盡降其眾。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he led eight thousand men from Bulahan and advanced to Ger Erge; the Dzungar army collapsed; more than two hundred heads were struck off in battle, more than a hundred zaisangs and others were captured, and all their followers surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year he led eight thousand men from Bulahan to Ger Erge. The Dzungar force broke; over two hundred were killed in action, more than a hundred zaisangs and others were taken, and the rest surrendered.

sentences.zh: 又焚烏蘭呼濟爾敵糧，引還。

translations.literal: He also burned enemy grain at Ulan Hujir and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He burned enemy grain stores at Ulan Hujir and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，命兼統祁里德軍，分兵駐巴里坤。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was ordered to command Qilide's army concurrently and divide troops to garrison Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 he was placed in overall command of Qilide's force as well and detached troops to garrison Barkol.

sentences.zh: 三年，召還，授內大臣。

translations.literal: In the third year he was recalled and appointed an inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was recalled and made an inner court minister.

sentences.zh: 四年，授黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed general of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed general of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 六年，授吏部尚書，賜雙眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed Minister of Personnel and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he became Minister of Personnel and was granted the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 初，青海羅卜藏丹津敗走，準噶爾策妄阿喇布坦納之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Lobzang Danjin of Qinghai was defeated and fled, the Dzungar Tsewang Araptan received him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, after Lobzang Danjin of Qinghai was defeated and fled, the Dzungar ruler Tsewang Araptan gave him refuge.

sentences.zh: 上屢遣使索獻，策妄阿喇布坦亦遣使請和，上罷兩路兵，久之議未決。

translations.literal: The emperor repeatedly sent envoys demanding his surrender; Tsewang Araptan also sent envoys suing for peace; the emperor halted the two-route armies, and for a long time deliberation did not reach a decision.
translations.idiomatic: The court repeatedly demanded that he be handed over, while Tsewang Araptan also sent peace envoys. The emperor suspended both campaigning armies, and for years the court could not settle on a policy.

sentences.zh: 策妄阿喇布坦死，子噶爾丹策零嗣，屢犯邊。

translations.literal: When Tsewang Araptan died, his son Galdan Tseren succeeded and repeatedly violated the border.
translations.idiomatic: After Tsewang Araptan died, his son Galdan Tseren succeeded and raided the frontier again and again.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，上命廷臣集議，大學士硃軾、左都御史沈近思皆言天時未至，副都統達福亦言不可，惟大學士張廷玉贊用兵，上意乃決，復出師。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year the emperor ordered court ministers to assemble in deliberation; Grand Secretary Zhu Shi and left censor-in-chief Shen Jinsi both said the season was not yet right, Vice President Dafu also said it could not be done, only Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu favored using troops, and the emperor's mind was then decided to campaign again.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year the emperor convened the court. Grand Secretary Zhu Shi and Left Censor-in-Chief Shen Jinsi argued that the time was not ripe; Vice President Dafu also opposed war. Only Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu urged military action, and on that basis the emperor resolved to march again.

sentences.zh: 命傅爾丹為靖邊大將軍，出北路；

translations.literal: Fu Erdan was appointed Pacification General of the Frontier and marched by the northern route;
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan was appointed Pacification General of the Frontier and took the northern route;

sentences.zh: 發京師八旗兵六千、車騎營兵九千、奉天等處兵八千八百，以巴賽為副將軍，順承郡王錫保掌振武將軍印，陳泰、袞泰、石禮哈、岱豪、達福、覺羅海蘭為參贊。

translations.literal: Six thousand Beijing Eight Banner troops, nine thousand Cavalry Brigade troops, and eight thousand eight hundred troops from Fengtian and other places were dispatched; Basei was made deputy general, Prince of Shuncheng Xibao held the seal of Martial Valor General, and Chen Tai, Guntai, Shi Liha, Dai Hao, Dafu, and Aisin Gioro Hailan were made staff controllers.
translations.idiomatic: The court mobilized six thousand Beijing bannermen, nine thousand Cavalry Brigade troops, and eight thousand eight hundred men from Fengtian and other garrisons. Basei served as deputy general; Prince Xibao of Shuncheng held the Martial Valor seal; and Chen Tai, Guntai, Shi Liha, Dai Hao, Dafu, and Aisin Gioro Hailan were named staff controllers.

sentences.zh: 定壽將前鋒，魏麟、閃文繡將車騎營，納秦將奉天兵，塔爾岱、西彌賴將索倫兵，費雅思哈將寧古塔兵，阿三將右衛兵，素圖將寧夏兵，承保、常祿將察哈爾兵，馬爾齊、袞布將土默特兵，丹巴、沙津達賴將喀喇沁、土默特兵，法敏、伊都立、巴泰、西琳、傅德理餉，永國護印。

translations.literal: Dingshou commanded the vanguard; Wei Lin and Shan Wenxiu commanded the Cavalry Brigade; Na Qin commanded the Fengtian troops; Tardai and Ximilai commanded the Solon troops; Feiyasihā commanded the Ningguta troops; A San commanded the Right Guard troops; Su Tu commanded the Ningxia troops; Chengbao and Chang Lu commanded the Chahar troops; Maerqi and Gunbu commanded the Tümed troops; Danba and Shajindalai commanded the Kharachin and Tümed troops; Famin, Yiduli, Batai, Xilin, and Fude managed supplies; Yongguo guarded the seal.
translations.idiomatic: Dingshou led the vanguard; Wei Lin and Shan Wenxiu the Cavalry Brigade; Na Qin the Fengtian detachments; Tardai and Ximilai the Solon; Feiyasihā the Ningguta; A San the Right Guard; Su Tu the Ningxia; Chengbao and Chang Lu the Chahar; Maerqi and Gunbu the Tümed; Danba and Shajindalai the Kharachin and Tümed auxiliaries. Famin, Yiduli, Batai, Xilin, and Fude handled supplies, and Yongguo guarded the general's seal.

sentences.zh: 上祭告太廟，幸南苑閱車騎營兵，禦太和殿行授鉞禮，賜傅爾丹御用朝珠、黃帶、紫轡、白金五千，加少保。

translations.literal: The emperor offered sacrifice and reported to the Imperial Ancestral Temple, visited the Southern Park to review Cavalry Brigade troops, proceeded to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to perform the ceremony of bestowing the battle-axe, and granted Fu Erdan the imperial court beads, yellow belt, purple bridle, and five thousand taels of silver, with the added title Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reported to the ancestral temple, reviewed the Cavalry Brigade in the Southern Park, and in the Hall of Supreme Harmony performed the rite of granting the commander's axe. Fu Erdan received the emperor's own court beads, yellow belt, purple bridle, five thousand taels of silver, and the title Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 出駐阿爾泰。

translations.literal: He went out to encamp at Altai.
translations.idiomatic: He marched out and encamped at Altai.

sentences.zh: 八年，噶爾丹策零表請執羅卜藏丹津以獻，上命緩進兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Galdan Tseren memorialized offering to seize Lobzang Danjin and present him; the emperor ordered a slower advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Galdan Tseren offered to arrest Lobzang Danjin and deliver him to the court, and the emperor ordered the advance slowed.

sentences.zh: 尋召與兵鍾琪同詣京師議軍事，遣還軍。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was summoned together with the campaigning general Zhongqi to come to the capital to discuss military affairs, then sent back to the army.
translations.idiomatic: He and the campaigning general Zhongqi were soon summoned to the capital to discuss strategy, then sent back to their commands.

sentences.zh: 九年，疏言科布多為進兵孔道，請仍於此築城，下廷議，如所請。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he memorialized that Kobdo was the vital route for advancing troops and asked again to build a city there; it was referred to court deliberation and approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he argued that Kobdo was the main corridor for advance and again asked to fortify it. The ministries approved his request.

sentences.zh: 五月，傅爾丹移軍科布多，噶爾丹策零遣所部嗒蘇爾海丹巴為間，為守卡侍衛所獲，詰之，曰：「噶爾丹策零發兵三萬，使大策零敦多卜、小策零敦多卜分將犯北路。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Fu Erdan moved the army to Kobdo; Galdan Tseren sent his subordinate Tasurhai Danba as a spy; he was captured by a border-guard attendant; under interrogation he said: "Galdan Tseren has dispatched thirty thousand troops, with the Greater Tsewang Donjub and Lesser Tsewang Donjub dividing command to invade the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Fu Erdan shifted his headquarters to Kobdo. Galdan Tseren sent a spy named Tasurhai Danba, who was seized by a border guard. Under questioning he said that Galdan Tseren had mobilized thirty thousand men under the Greater and Lesser Tsewang Donjub to strike the northern route.

sentences.zh: 小策零敦多卜已至察罕哈達，大策零敦多卜以事宿留未至。」

translations.literal: The Lesser Tsewang Donjub had already reached Chaghan Hada; the Greater Tsewang Donjub was detained on business and had not yet arrived."
translations.idiomatic: The Lesser Tsewang Donjub had already reached Chaghan Hada, while the Greater Tsewang Donjub was still delayed on other business.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹信其語，計及其未集擊之。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan believed his words and planned to strike before they had fully assembled.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan believed the report and resolved to attack before the enemy could concentrate.

sentences.zh: 令選兵萬人，循科布多河西以進，素圖、岱豪為前鋒，定壽等領第一隊，馬爾薩等領第二隊，傅爾丹舉大兵繼其後，令袞泰護築城，陳泰屯科布多河東，斷奇蘭道。

translations.literal: He ordered ten thousand picked troops to advance along the west bank of the Kobdo River; Su Tu and Dai Hao were vanguard; Dingshou and others led the first column, Maersa and others the second; Fu Erdan followed with the main force; Guntai was ordered to protect the city-building; Chen Tai encamped east of the Kobdo River to cut the Qilan road.
translations.idiomatic: He selected ten thousand men to march along the west bank of the Kobdo. Su Tu and Dai Hao led the vanguard; Dingshou commanded the first column and Maersa the second; Fu Erdan followed with the main body. Guntai was left to oversee the fortifications, Chen Tai to hold the east bank of the Kobdo and block the Qilan route.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，師發科布多，定壽等進次扎克賽河，獲准噶爾邏卒，言距察罕哈達止三日程，準噶爾兵不過千人，未立營。

translations.literal: On gengzi day of the sixth month the army set out from Kobdo; Dingshou and others advanced to the Zhakesai River, captured a Dzungar border scout, who said Chaghan Hada was only three days' march away, Dzungar troops numbered no more than a thousand, and they had not yet pitched camp.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the sixth month the army left Kobdo. Dingshou advanced to the Zhakesai River and took a Dzungar scout, who said Chaghan Hada lay only three days away, that no more than a thousand enemy troops were present, and that they had not yet encamped.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹命乘夜速進，行數日不見敵。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan ordered a rapid night advance; after marching several days no enemy was seen.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan ordered a forced night march, but after several days still found no enemy.

sentences.zh: 戊申，獲諜，言準噶爾兵二千屯博克托嶺。

translations.literal: On wushen day a spy was captured who said two thousand Dzungar troops were encamped at Boketu Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day another spy was taken, who reported two thousand Dzungars at Boketu Ridge.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹遣素圖、岱豪將三千人往擊之。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan dispatched Su Tu and Dai Hao with three thousand men to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan sent Su Tu and Dai Hao with three thousand men to attack.

sentences.zh: 敵出羸兵誘師，而伏二萬人谷中。

translations.literal: The enemy sent out weak troops to lure the army, while twenty thousand men lay in ambush in the valley.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy put forward a weak screen to bait the Qing force while twenty thousand men waited in ambush in the valley.

sentences.zh: 己酉，定壽師次庫列圖嶺，遇敵，斬四百餘級，敵驅駝馬踰嶺遁。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Dingshou's army halted at Kulietu Ridge, met the enemy, cut off more than four hundred heads, and the enemy drove camels and horses over the ridge and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Dingshou reached Kulietu Ridge, engaged the enemy, killed more than four hundred, and watched them drive their camels and horses over the pass in flight.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，傅爾丹師至，素圖、定壽皆會。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Fu Erdan's army arrived and joined Su Tu and Dingshou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Fu Erdan came up and joined Su Tu and Dingshou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，逐敵入谷，伏發，據高阜衝擊。

translations.literal: On xinhai day they pursued the enemy into the valley; the ambush sprang, and from high ground they charged down in attack.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Qing columns pursued the enemy into the valley, where the ambush closed and attackers poured down from the heights.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹督戰，殺敵千餘，塔爾岱、馬爾齊督兵奪西山，敵據險，師攻之不能克。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan directed the battle and killed more than a thousand of the enemy; Tardai and Maerqi directed troops to seize the western hill, but the enemy held the difficult ground and the army could not overcome them in attack.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan directed the fighting and more than a thousand enemy were killed. Tardai and Maerqi tried to take the western hill, but the enemy held the high ground and the assault failed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，傅爾丹令移軍和通呼爾哈諾爾，定壽、素圖、覺羅海蘭、常祿、西彌賴據山梁東，塔爾岱、馬爾齊據其西，承保居中，馬爾薩出其東，達福、岱豪當前，舒楞額、沙津達賴等護後。

translations.literal: On renzi day Fu Erdan ordered the army to move to Hetong Hu'erhanuo'er; Dingshou, Su Tu, Aisin Gioro Hailan, Chang Lu, and Ximilai held the eastern ridge; Tardai and Maerqi held the west; Chengbao held the center; Maersa came out on the east; Dafu and Dai Hao faced the front; Shulenge, Shajindalai, and others guarded the rear.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Fu Erdan drew the army back to Hetong Hu'erhanuo'er. Dingshou, Su Tu, Aisin Gioro Hailan, Chang Lu, and Ximilai held the eastern ridge; Tardai and Maerqi the west; Chengbao the center; Maersa on the east flank; Dafu and Dai Hao in the van; and Shulenge, Shajindalai, and others in the rear guard.

sentences.zh: 師甫移，敵力攻山梁東西二軍，定壽等奮戰。

translations.literal: The army had barely moved when the enemy pressed hard against the eastern and western ridge forces; Dingshou and others fought fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: Hardly had the army shifted position when the enemy threw their full weight against both ridge forces, and Dingshou and his officers fought desperately.

sentences.zh: 大風雨雹，師為敵所圍。

translations.literal: A great wind blew with rain and hail, and the army was surrounded by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: A violent storm of wind, rain, and hail broke, and the army found itself encircled.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹遣兵援塔爾岱出，又令承保援定壽，日暮，圍未解。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan sent troops to rescue Tardai and bring him out, and also ordered Chengbao to relieve Dingshou; by nightfall the encirclement had not been broken.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan sent men to break Tardai out and ordered Chengbao to relieve Dingshou, but by nightfall the ring had not been broken.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，海蘭突圍出，定壽、素圖、馬爾齊皆自殺；

translations.literal: On guichou day Hailan broke out of the encirclement; Dingshou, Su Tu, and Maerqi all killed themselves;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Hailan fought his way out, while Dingshou, Su Tu, and Maerqi each took their own lives;

sentences.zh: 西彌賴令索倫兵赴援，兵潰，亦自殺。

translations.literal: Ximilai ordered Solon troops to go to their aid; the troops collapsed, and he too killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Ximilai ordered Solon troops forward to help, but they broke and fled, and he killed himself as well.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，敵環攻大營，傅爾丹督兵御之，殺敵五百餘。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the enemy pressed the great camp on all sides; Fu Erdan directed the troops in defense and killed more than five hundred of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the enemy closed on the main camp from every side. Fu Erdan directed the defense and killed more than five hundred of them.

sentences.zh: 科爾沁兵潰，沙津達賴奮戰入敵陣，師望見其纛，曰：「土默特兵陷賊矣！」

translations.literal: The Khorchin troops collapsed; Shajindalai fought fiercely into the enemy formation; the army saw his banner and said: "The Tümed troops have fallen into the enemy!"
translations.idiomatic: The Khorchin contingent broke. Shajindalai charged deep into the enemy lines, and when the army saw his banner they cried, "The Tümed have been cut off!"

sentences.zh: 遂大潰。

translations.literal: The army then collapsed in great rout.
translations.idiomatic: At that the whole force dissolved in rout.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，永國、海蘭、岱豪皆自殺。

translations.literal: On yimao day Yongguo, Hailan, and Dai Hao all killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Yongguo, Hailan, and Dai Hao all took their own lives.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹雜士伍中以出。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan mingled among the common soldiers to get out.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan slipped out disguised among the rank and file.

sentences.zh: 敵大集，查弼納、巴賽、達福、馬爾薩、舒楞額皆戰死。

translations.literal: The enemy gathered in force; Zhabina, Basei, Dafu, Maersa, and Shulenge all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: As the enemy massed, Zhabina, Basei, Dafu, Maersa, and Shulenge were all killed in action.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹率殘兵渡哈爾噶納河，敵追至，擊殺五百餘人。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan led the remnant troops across the Khargana River; the enemy pursued to the river and more than five hundred were struck down and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan led the survivors across the Khargana River. The pursuers caught up at the crossing, and more than five hundred of them were killed.

sentences.zh: 七月壬戌朔，還至科布多，收餘兵僅存二千餘。

translations.literal: On the first day renxu of the seventh month he returned to Kobdo and gathered the remnant troops, barely more than two thousand remaining.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month he returned to Kobdo with barely two thousand survivors.

sentences.zh: 方戰，科爾沁蒙古兵先敗，傅爾丹聞人言，謂先敗者土默特兵也。

translations.literal: During the battle the Khorchin Mongol troops were the first to collapse; Fu Erdan heard people say that those who had collapsed first were the Tümed troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fighting the Khorchin Mongols broke first, but Fu Erdan heard reports that blamed the Tümed contingent.

sentences.zh: 劾沙津達賴，論斬。

translations.literal: He impeached Shajindalai, who was sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Shajindalai, who was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 歸化城土默特副都統袞布降敵，戮其孥。

translations.literal: Gunbu, vice president of the Tümed at Guihuacheng, surrendered to the enemy; his family was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Gunbu, the Tümed vice president at Guihuacheng, defected to the enemy, and his family was put to death.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹疏請罪，上諭曰：「損兵誠有罪，朕因爾等竭蹶力戰，特寬恕之。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan memorialized asking to be punished; the emperor instructed: "Loss of troops is indeed a crime, but because you exhausted yourselves fighting with all your strength, I specially pardon you.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan submitted a confession. The emperor replied: "Losing troops is indeed a fault, but because you fought yourselves to exhaustion, I pardon you.

sentences.zh: 痛惻難忍，不覺淚下！

translations.literal: The grief is unbearable—I cannot keep from shedding tears!
translations.idiomatic: My grief is more than I can bear; tears come unbidden!

sentences.zh: 解朕親束帶賜傅爾丹。

translations.literal: I remove my own belt and bestow it on Fu Erdan.
translations.idiomatic: I give Fu Erdan the belt from my own waist.

sentences.zh: 爾等毋妄動，敵至能堅守，即爾等之功。

translations.literal: Do not act rashly; if when the enemy comes you can hold firm, that will be your merit.
translations.idiomatic: Do not move rashly. If you can hold your ground when the enemy comes, that will be merit enough.

sentences.zh: 科布多不能守，可還軍察罕廋爾。」

translations.literal: If Kobdo cannot be held, you may withdraw the army to Chaghan Shou'er."
translations.idiomatic: If Kobdo cannot be held, withdraw to Chaghan Shou'er."

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹复疏請罪，上諭曰：「輕信賊言，冒險深入，中賊詭計，是爾之罪。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan again memorialized asking to be punished; the emperor instructed: "Believing the enemy's words lightly, venturing deep in peril, and falling into the enemy's stratagem—that is your crime.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan confessed again. The emperor said: "Believing enemy reports, plunging deep into danger, and falling into their trap—that is your fault.

sentences.zh: 至不肯輕生自殺，力戰全歸，此爾能辨別輕重。

translations.literal: As for refusing to take your life lightly and fighting your way back whole—that shows you can distinguish what matters.
translations.idiomatic: But refusing suicide and fighting your way back alive shows you know what truly matters.

sentences.zh: 事定，朕自有處置。」

translations.literal: When affairs are settled, I shall deal with you myself."
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ends, I shall decide your case myself."

sentences.zh: 尋命以錫保為靖邊大將軍，傅爾丹掌振武將軍印，協辦軍務。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Xibao was appointed Pacification General of the Frontier, Fu Erdan held the seal of Martial Valor General, and assisted in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Xibao was made Pacification General of the Frontier while Fu Erdan kept the Martial Valor seal and assisted in command.

sentences.zh: 十年七月，準噶爾侵烏遜珠勒，錫保令傅爾丹將三千人御之，敗績。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year the Dzungars invaded Wusun Zhule; Xibao ordered Fu Erdan to lead three thousand men to resist them, and they were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year the Dzungars raided Wusun Zhule. Xibao sent Fu Erdan with three thousand men to repel them, and they were beaten again.

sentences.zh: 錫保疏劾，罷領侍衛內大臣、振武將軍，削公爵。

translations.literal: Xibao memorialized in impeachment; Fu Erdan was dismissed from chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard and Martial Valor General, and stripped of his dukedom.
translations.idiomatic: Xibao impeached him. Fu Erdan lost his posts as chief bodyguard commandant and Martial Valor General and was stripped of his dukedom.

sentences.zh: 十一年，錫保再疏劾傅爾丹，上察傅爾丹兵寡，原其罪，命留軍效力。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Xibao again memorialized impeaching Fu Erdan; the emperor saw that Fu Erdan's troops were few and excused his crime, ordering him to remain with the army and render service.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Xibao impeached him again, but the emperor saw that Fu Erdan had too few troops and pardoned him, ordering him to remain at the front and serve.

sentences.zh: 十三年，伊都立等侵軍餉事發，辭連傅爾丹，命侍郎海望逮詣京師下獄，並追論和通呼爾哈諾爾及烏遜珠勒失機罪，王大臣等依律擬斬。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the case of Yiduli and others embezzling military funds came to light, implicating Fu Erdan; Vice Minister Haiwang was ordered to arrest him and bring him to the capital for imprisonment, and his failures at Hetong Hu'erhanuo'er and Wusun Zhule were pursued; princes and ministers applied the statute and recommended execution.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the embezzlement case of Yiduli and others implicated Fu Erdan. Vice Minister Haiwang was sent to arrest him and bring him to the capital. His defeats at Hetong Hu'erhanuo'er and Wusun Zhule were reviewed, and the princes and ministers recommended death under statute.

sentences.zh: 命未下，世宗崩，高宗即位，命改監候。

translations.literal: Before the order was issued, the Shizong emperor died; the Gaozong emperor succeeded and ordered the sentence changed to imprisonment awaiting execution.
translations.idiomatic: Before the sentence could be carried out, the Yongzheng emperor died and Qianlong succeeded, commuting the penalty to imprisonment awaiting execution.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年，與岳鍾琪並釋出獄。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong he was released from prison together with Yue Zhongqi.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 4 he was released from prison together with Yue Zhongqi.

sentences.zh: 十三年，師討大金川未下，授內大臣、護軍統領，赴軍，尋命署川陝總督，與鍾琪治軍事。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, as the campaign against Greater Jinchuan had not succeeded, he was appointed inner court minister and commandant of the Guard Corps, went to the army, and was soon ordered to act as Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general and manage military affairs with Zhongqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, while the campaign against Greater Jinchuan dragged on, he was made inner court minister and commandant of the Guard Corps and sent to the front. He was soon named acting Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general to manage affairs with Zhongqi.

sentences.zh: 大學士傅恆出為經略，奏傅爾丹衰老，惟熟於管理滿洲兵，請專治營壘諸事。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Fu Heng went out as campaign superintendent and memorialized that Fu Erdan was aged, knew only how to manage Manchu troops, and asked that he be put solely in charge of camps and fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Fu Heng took the field as superintendent and reported that Fu Erdan was old and fit only for managing Manchu camps and fortifications.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命為參贊。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed staff controller.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was named a staff controller.

sentences.zh: 大金川師罷，授黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: When the Greater Jinchuan campaign ended, he was appointed general of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: When the Greater Jinchuan campaign ended, he was appointed general of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒，賜祭葬，諡溫愨。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died; funeral sacrifices were granted, and he was given the posthumous title Wennu.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventeenth year. The court granted funeral rites and gave him the posthumous title Wennu.

sentences.zh: 子兆德，襲爵；

translations.literal: His son Zhaode inherited the title;
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhaode succeeded to the title;

sentences.zh: 哈達哈，自有傳。

translations.literal: Hadaha has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Hadaha is treated in a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹頎然岳立，面微赬，美鬚髯。

translations.literal: Fu Erdan stood tall as a mountain peak, his face slightly ruddy, with a fine beard and whiskers.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan was tall and imposing, with a slightly ruddy face and a handsome beard.

sentences.zh: 其為大將軍，廷玉實薦之。

translations.literal: When he became grand general, it was in fact Tingyu who recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: His appointment as grand general had in fact come through Zhang Tingyu's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪嘗過其帳，見壁上刀槊森然，問：「安用此？」

translations.literal: Zhongqi once passed his tent, saw blades and spears bristling on the wall, and asked: "What use are these?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi once visited his tent, saw blades and spears bristling on the walls, and asked, "What are these for?"

sentences.zh: 傅爾丹曰：「此吾所素習者，懸以勵眾。」

translations.literal: Fu Erdan said: "These are what I have always practiced; I hang them to encourage the troops."
translations.idiomatic: Fu Erdan replied, "These are the arms I have always trained with. I hang them here to hearten the men."

sentences.zh: 鍾琪出曰：「為大將，不恃謀而恃勇，敗矣！」

translations.literal: Zhongqi left saying: "As a grand general, relying on courage rather than strategy—you are doomed to defeat!"
translations.idiomatic: As he left, Zhongqi said, "A commander who trusts courage instead of strategy is already beaten."

sentences.zh: 馬爾賽，馬佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人，大學士、三等公圖海孫。

translations.literal: Ma Ersai, of the Majia clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and grandson of Grand Secretary and third-rank duke Tu Hai.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ersai, of the Majia clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a grandson of Grand Secretary Tu Hai, who held the third-rank dukedom.

sentences.zh: 馬爾賽，襲爵。

translations.literal: Ma Ersai inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ersai succeeded to the title.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，迭授護軍統領、鑲黃旗蒙古都統、領侍衛內大臣，掌鑾儀衛事。

translations.literal: During the Kangxi reign he was successively appointed commandant of the Guard Corps, commandant-general of the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner, and chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard, directing the Imperial Procession Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Under Kangxi he served in turn as commandant of the Guard Corps, commandant-general of the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner, and chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard, overseeing the procession guard.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，加贈圖海一等公，號曰忠達，仍以馬爾賽襲。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng Tu Hai was posthumously raised to first-rank duke with the style Zhongda, and Ma Ersai still inherited.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 Tu Hai was posthumously raised to first-rank duke with the style Zhongda, and Ma Ersai continued to inherit the line.

sentences.zh: 調鑲藍旗滿洲。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 六年，授武英殿大學士，兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall and concurrently Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he became Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall and concurrent Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 八年，命與大學士張廷玉、蔣廷錫詳議軍行事宜。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered together with Grand Secretaries Zhang Tingyu and Jiang Tingshi to deliberate in detail on military campaign affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined Grand Secretaries Zhang Tingyu and Jiang Tingshi in detailed planning for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 尋以翊贊機務，加一等阿達哈哈番世職。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, for assisting in state affairs, he was given the added hereditary office of first-class adaha gusa rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, for assisting in state affairs, he received the added hereditary rank of first-class adaha gusa.

sentences.zh: 九年，靖邊大將軍傅爾丹討噶爾丹策零，師敗績。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Pacification General of the Frontier Fu Erdan campaigned against Galdan Tseren and the army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Pacification General Fu Erdan marched against Galdan Tseren and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 授撫遠大將軍，調西路副將軍覺羅伊禮佈為參贊，率師駐圖拉。

translations.literal: Ma Ersai was appointed Pacification General of the Far Reaches; Western Route Deputy General Aisin Gioro Yilibu was transferred as staff controller; he led the army to encamp at Tula.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ersai was made Pacification General of the Far Reaches, with Western Route Deputy General Aisin Gioro Yilibu as staff controller, and encamped the army at Tula.

sentences.zh: 馬爾賽師行，聞準噶爾將犯科布多，奏請暫駐第十五台。

translations.literal: As Ma Ersai's army marched, he heard the Dzungars were about to attack Kobdo and memorialized asking to halt temporarily at the fifteenth relay station.
translations.idiomatic: As his army marched, he heard the Dzungars were threatening Kobdo and asked to halt at the fifteenth relay station.

sentences.zh: 俄聞準噶爾兵屯科布多近處，又奏請進駐察罕廋爾；

translations.literal: Soon he heard Dzungar troops were encamped near Kobdo and again memorialized asking to advance and encamp at Chaghan Shou'er;
translations.idiomatic: Soon he heard Dzungar troops were near Kobdo and asked to advance to Chaghan Shou'er;

sentences.zh: 既又聞準噶爾兵至奎素，復奏請調蒙、漢兵七千人赴推河。

translations.literal: then again heard Dzungar troops had reached Kuisu and memorialized again asking to transfer seven thousand Mongol and Han troops to the Tui River.
translations.idiomatic: then heard they had reached Kuisu and asked to move seven thousand Mongol and Han troops to the Tui River.

sentences.zh: 上責馬爾賽展轉不定，命駐第十四台待命。

translations.literal: The emperor reproached Ma Ersai for shifting back and forth without decision and ordered him to encamp at the fourteenth relay station and await orders.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Ma Ersai for vacillation and ordered him to hold the fourteenth relay station and await orders.

sentences.zh: 旋命將蒙、漢兵五千人駐翁袞。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was ordered to station five thousand Mongol and Han troops at Ongon.
translations.idiomatic: He was then told to post five thousand Mongol and Han troops at Ongon.

sentences.zh: 上解傅爾丹靖邊大將軍印授順承郡王錫保，諭馬爾賽，蒙古諸扎薩克俱遵靖邊大將軍調遣，不得以撫遠大將軍印有所徵發。

translations.literal: The emperor removed Fu Erdan's seal as Pacification General of the Frontier and gave it to Prince of Shuncheng Xibao, instructing Ma Ersai that all Mongol jasaks were to follow the Pacification General of the Frontier's orders and that he might not requisition anything under the Pacification General of the Far Reaches seal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor transferred Fu Erdan's seal as Pacification General of the Frontier to Prince Xibao of Shuncheng and told Ma Ersai that all Mongol jasaks answered to that command, not to his own Pacification General of the Far Reaches seal.

sentences.zh: 尋改授撫遠將軍，駐紮克拜達里克。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was reassigned as Pacification General of the Far Reaches and encamped at Zakhbaydarik.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon reassigned as Pacification General of the Far Reaches and stationed at Zakhbaydarik.

sentences.zh: 十年秋，準噶爾大舉內犯，掠喀爾喀諸部。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the tenth year the Dzungars launched a major invasion within the frontier and plundered the Khalkha tribes.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Dzungars invaded in force and ravaged the Khalkha tribes.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀親王策棱與戰額爾德尼昭，大破之，餘眾循鄂爾昆河源走推河。

translations.literal: Khalkha Prince Celeng fought them at Erdeni Juu and inflicted a great defeat; the remnant force followed the Ergun headwaters toward the Tui River.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha Prince Celeng met them at Erdeni Juu and routed them. The survivors fled along the Ergun headwaters toward the Tui River.

sentences.zh: 錫保劄馬爾賽，令與建勳將軍達爾濟合軍截擊，喀爾喀親王丹津多爾濟亦馳報，促馬爾賽發兵。

translations.literal: Xibao sent a dispatch to Ma Ersai ordering him to join Merit-Building General Daerji in combined forces to intercept; Khalkha Prince Danjindorji also sent urgent word urging Ma Ersai to march.
translations.idiomatic: Xibao ordered Ma Ersai to join Merit-Building General Daerji in cutting off the retreat. Khalkha Prince Danjindorji also sent urgent word urging him to march.

sentences.zh: 馬爾賽集諸將議，諾爾琿曰：「我等當速發兵迎截，遲且將不及。」

translations.literal: Ma Ersai assembled the generals for deliberation; Nuerhuan said: "We should quickly dispatch troops to intercept; if we delay we will not arrive in time."
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ersai called a council of generals. Nuerhuan said, "We must march at once to intercept them, or we shall be too late."

sentences.zh: 諸將皆和之，獨都統李杕以為但當守城，馬爾賽以杕言為然。

translations.literal: All the generals agreed, but only Commandant Li Di held that they should merely hold the city; Ma Ersai thought Di's view correct.
translations.idiomatic: The other generals agreed, but Commandant Li Di alone argued for holding the fort. Ma Ersai sided with Li Di.

sentences.zh: 諾爾琿、博爾屯等力請，傅鼐至跪求，馬爾賽持不可。

translations.literal: Nuerhuan, Bo'ertun, and others pressed hard; Fu Nai even knelt in pleading, but Ma Ersai remained adamant that it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Nuerhuan, Bo'ertun, and others pressed him hard, and Fu Nai knelt to plead, but Ma Ersai refused.

sentences.zh: 達爾濟遣使約會師，馬爾賽終不應。

translations.literal: Daerji sent an envoy to arrange a joint rendezvous; Ma Ersai ultimately did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: Daerji sent envoys to arrange a rendezvous, but Ma Ersai never responded.

sentences.zh: 士卒登城見敵過，奮欲出擊，參贊胡琳、傅鼐不待馬爾賽令，將所部以出，馬爾賽乃與偕行。

translations.literal: Soldiers climbed the walls, saw the enemy pass by, and were eager to sally out in attack; staff controllers Hu Lin and Fu Nai, without awaiting Ma Ersai's order, led their units out, and Ma Ersai then went along with them.
translations.idiomatic: Troops on the walls saw the enemy pass and clamored to attack. Staff controllers Hu Lin and Fu Nai marched out without waiting for orders, and Ma Ersai followed.

sentences.zh: 至博木喀拉，令欽拜將七百人逐敵，馬爾賽引還。

translations.literal: At Bomukala he ordered Qinbai to lead seven hundred men in pursuit of the enemy; Ma Ersai withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: At Bomukala he sent Qinbai with seven hundred men in pursuit, then withdrew himself.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾兵去已遠，欽拜等亦無所獲而返。

translations.literal: The Dzungar troops had already gone far away, and Qinbai and the others returned with nothing gained.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungars were already far away, and Qinbai returned empty-handed.

sentences.zh: 胡琳、欽拜、博爾屯、諾爾琿等先後疏報，上命奪馬爾賽官爵治罪，錫保等請誅馬爾賽及杕，部議當貽誤軍機律斬。

translations.literal: Hu Lin, Qinbai, Bo'ertun, Nuerhuan, and others memorialized in succession; the emperor ordered Ma Ersai stripped of office and title for punishment; Xibao and others asked that Ma Ersai and Di be executed; the ministries deliberated that under the statute for jeopardizing military affairs they should be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Lin, Qinbai, Bo'ertun, Nuerhuan, and others reported in turn. The emperor stripped Ma Ersai of rank and ordered him punished. Xibao and others asked for the execution of Ma Ersai and Li Di, and the ministries recommended death for jeopardizing military operations.

sentences.zh: 十二月，遣副都統索林赴扎克拜達里克，斬馬爾賽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Vice President Suolin was dispatched to Zakhbaydarik and beheaded Ma Ersai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Vice President Suolin was sent to Zakhbaydarik and executed Ma Ersai.

sentences.zh: 李杕，漢軍鑲藍旗人，李國翰四世孫。

translations.literal: Li Di, a Han bannerman of the Bordered Blue Banner, was a fourth-generation descendant of Li Guohan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Di, a Han bannerman of the Bordered Blue Banner, was a fourth-generation descendant of Li Guohan.

sentences.zh: 降襲三等伯，累擢至廣州將軍。

translations.literal: He inherited a demoted third-rank earldom and was promoted step by step to general of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited a demoted third-rank earldom and rose step by step to general of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 坐駐防兵閧巡撫官廨，逮京師論斬，上貸之，复授都統，仍令襲爵。

translations.literal: For garrison troops brawling at the provincial governor's yamen he was arrested and brought to the capital for sentencing to execution; the emperor spared him, again appointed him commandant, and still ordered him to inherit the title.
translations.idiomatic: When his garrison troops brawled at the governor's yamen he was brought to the capital for execution, but the emperor spared him, restored him as commandant, and let him keep the title.

sentences.zh: 至是，責其一言僨事，罪與馬爾賽等，奪官爵，論斬。

translations.literal: On this occasion he was blamed because a single remark had ruined the affair; his crime was equal to Ma Ersai's; he was stripped of office and title and sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: Now he was blamed because one remark had ruined the operation. His crime was judged equal to Ma Ersai's; he was stripped of rank and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 慶復，字瑞園，佟佳氏，滿州鑲黃旗人，佟國維第六子。

translations.literal: Qing Fu, courtesy name Ruiyuan, of the Tunggiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and the sixth son of Tung Guowei.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Fu, whose courtesy name was Ruiyuan, belonged to the Tunggiya clan and served as a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner. He was the sixth son of Tung Guowei.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，襲一等公，授散秩大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng he inherited the first-rank duke's title and was appointed a minister without specific portfolio.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 he succeeded to the first-rank dukedom and was made a minister without portfolio.

sentences.zh: 遷鑾儀使，兼領武備院事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to director of the Imperial Procession and concurrently directed affairs of the Armory.
translations.idiomatic: He became director of the Imperial Procession and also oversaw the Armory.

sentences.zh: 七年，授正白旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed vice president of the Han Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made vice president of the Han Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷正藍旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to commandant-general of the Han Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became commandant-general of the Han Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 九年，列議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was listed among the deliberative ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined the ranks of deliberative ministers.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授工部尚書，署刑部，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed Minister of Works, acted for the Ministry of Punishments, and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he became Minister of Works, acted for the Ministry of Punishments, and was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十二年，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was appointed chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he became chief commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 十三年，高宗即位，命代平郡王福彭為定邊大將軍，出北路。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, when the Gaozong emperor succeeded, he was ordered to replace Prince of Ping Fu Peng as Pacification General of the Frontier and march by the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: When Qianlong succeeded in the thirteenth year, he was ordered to replace Prince Fu Peng of Ping as Pacification General of the Frontier and take the northern route.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，準噶爾乞和，罷兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong the Dzungars sued for peace and the troops were halted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 the Dzungars sued for peace and the campaign was halted.

sentences.zh: 慶復請沿邊設卡倫，以侍衛或護軍一專管，喀爾喀台吉一協理；

translations.literal: Qing Fu asked to set up karun posts along the border, with one attendant or guardsman in exclusive charge and one Khalkha taiji to assist;
translations.idiomatic: Qing Fu proposed border karun posts, each managed by one attendant or guardsman with a Khalkha taiji to assist;

sentences.zh: 發土謝圖、賽因諾顏、扎薩克圖、車臣四部兵合三千人，歲六月集鄂爾坤出巡，九月罷歸牧：詔如所請。

translations.literal: to mobilize three thousand troops combined from the four Khalkha leagues of Tüsheetü, Sayin Noyan, Zasagtu, and Chahar, assembling at the Orkhon in the sixth month each year for patrol, and dismissing them back to pasture in the ninth month: an edict approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: and to mobilize three thousand men from the four Khalkha leagues to assemble at the Orkhon each sixth month for patrol and return to pasture in the ninth. The court approved his plan.

sentences.zh: 召還京，署吏部尚書，兼戶部，尋真除刑部。

translations.literal: He was recalled to the capital, acted as Minister of Personnel, concurrently held the Ministry of Revenue, and soon received substantive appointment to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to the capital, he acted as Minister of Personnel and concurrently oversaw Revenue before receiving a substantive appointment as Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 二年，授兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 劾江西巡撫俞兆岳貪鄙營私，奪官，論如律。

translations.literal: He impeached Jiangxi provincial governor Yu Zhaoyue for greed, baseness, and pursuing private gain; Yu was stripped of office and sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached the Jiangxi governor Yu Zhaoyue for corruption and private gain. Yu was stripped of office and sentenced under law.

sentences.zh: 疏言蘇、常、揚、鎮、通、泰諸屬例徵麥二萬餘石，請改徵米，從之。

translations.literal: He memorialized that the subordinate districts of Suzhou, Changzhou, Yangzhou, Zhenjiang, Tongzhou, and Taizhou customarily levied more than twenty thousand shi of wheat and asked to change the levy to rice; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He reported that districts under Suzhou, Changzhou, Yangzhou, Zhenjiang, Tongzhou, and Taizhou customarily levied more than twenty thousand shi of wheat and asked to switch the levy to rice. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 移督雲、貴。

translations.literal: He was transferred to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was given the added title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he received the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 五年，疏言：「雲南府屬縣引南汁等六河溉田，山溪箐澗水發不常，沙石壅遏，堤埂易決。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he memorialized: "The counties subordinate to Yunnan Prefecture draw on six rivers such as the Nan Zhi to irrigate fields; mountain streams and ravine waters rise irregularly, sand and stone block the flow, and dikes and embankments easily burst.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he reported: "The counties under Yunnan Prefecture irrigate fields from six rivers including the Nan Zhi. Mountain streams rise unpredictably, sand and stone choke the channels, and dikes break easily.

sentences.zh: 請以時修治。」

translations.literal: I ask that they be repaired in season."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that they be repaired on schedule."

sentences.zh: 上嘉之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended the proposal.

sentences.zh: 又言：「滇、黔、粵、蜀四省接壤，瑤、苗雜處，往往爭界構訟，積案莫結。

translations.literal: He also said: "The four provinces of Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangdong, and Sichuan border one another; Yao and Miao are intermixed, and they often dispute boundaries and bring lawsuits, with accumulated cases that cannot be closed.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangdong, and Sichuan share borders where Yao and Miao communities are intermixed. Boundary disputes and lawsuits pile up without resolution.

sentences.zh: 如廣西鎮安屬小鎮安土州與雲南廣南屬土目爭剝頭、者賴二村，臣令詳勘，以村入廣西境應歸廣西；

translations.literal: For example, Xiaozhen'an Tusi under Guangxi Zhen'an and a native official under Yunnan Guangnan disputed the two villages of Botou and Zhelai; your servant ordered detailed survey, and because the villages lay within Guangxi territory they should belong to Guangxi;
translations.idiomatic: For example, the Xiaozhen'an chieftain under Guangxi Zhen'an and a native official under Yunnan Guangnan disputed the villages of Botou and Zhelai. I ordered a detailed survey and found the villages lay within Guangxi and should belong to Guangxi;

sentences.zh: 而廣西又議以小鎮安土州歸雲南，畫昭陽關為界。

translations.literal: but Guangxi also deliberated returning Xiaozhen'an Tusi to Yunnan and drawing Zhaoyang Pass as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: but Guangxi also proposed transferring the entire Xiaozhen'an chieftaincy to Yunnan and making Zhaoyang Pass the boundary.

sentences.zh: 雲南、四川於金沙江分界，雲南屬江驛、七戛、則補、晉毛諸地越在江外，兩省駐汛分防，犬牙互制，而四川又欲劃江分界。

translations.literal: Yunnan and Sichuan took the Jinsha River as their boundary; Yunnan-administered places such as Jiangyi, Qijia, Zebui, and Jinmao all lay beyond the river, the two provinces stationed garrison troops for divided defense in interlocking fashion, yet Sichuan again wished to draw the river as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan and Sichuan were divided at the Jinsha River, yet Yunnan-held districts such as Jiangyi, Qijia, Zebui, and Jinmao all lay on the far bank. Both provinces posted garrison troops in a checkerboard of mutual restraint, while Sichuan again pressed to make the river the line.

sentences.zh: 現在民、夷寧帖，應仍舊貫，不必紛更。

translations.literal: Now the people and the yi are peaceful and settled; they should follow the old practice and need not be changed in confusion.
translations.idiomatic: The people and the tribes are now at peace; the old arrangements should stand, without further upheaval.

sentences.zh: 其或田在彼境，糧在此境，當以糧從田，俾免牽混。」

translations.literal: Where fields lie in that jurisdiction but grain tax is levied in this, grain tax should follow the fields, so as to avoid entanglement."
translations.idiomatic: Where land lies in one province but tax is registered in another, tax liability should follow the land, to prevent mixed jurisdiction."

sentences.zh: 下軍機大臣議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was referred to the Grand Council for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent down to the Grand Council for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 又疏言錢價日昂，請省城增十爐，臨安增五爐，發餉銀七錢三。

translations.literal: He again memorialized that the price of cash rose daily, asking that the provincial capital add ten mint furnaces and Lin'an add five, and that pay silver be issued at seven qian and three fen.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that cash was rising in value daily and asked for ten additional mint furnaces at the provincial capital, five at Lin'an, and that troops be paid at seven mace and three candareens of silver.

sentences.zh: 下部議行。

translations.literal: It was sent to the ministry for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was sent to the relevant ministry for approval and implementation.

sentences.zh: 又分疏請開姚州鹽井，南安州屬咢嘉、大小猛光、回子門諸地招墾，濬治金沙江。

translations.literal: He again submitted separate memorials asking to open the Yao Prefecture salt wells, to recruit settlers in Ejia, Da Mengguang, Xiao Mengguang, Huizimen, and other places under Nan'an Prefecture, and to dredge the Jinsha River.
translations.idiomatic: He also filed separate memorials to open the Yao Prefecture salt wells, encourage reclamation in Ejia, Da Mengguang, Xiao Mengguang, Huizimen, and other districts under Nan'an Prefecture, and dredge the Jinsha River.

sentences.zh: 旋移督兩廣，疏劾粵海關監督鄭伍賽需索侵蝕，擬罪如律。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to govern Liang Guang and memorialized impeaching the Guangdong Customs Supervisor Zheng Wusai for extortion and embezzlement; he was sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to the Liangguang post, where he impeached the Guangdong customs supervisor Zheng Wusai for extortion and embezzlement; the case was sentenced under statute.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「瓊州四面環海，中有五指山，黎人所居。

translations.literal: He again memorialized: "Qiongzhou is surrounded by sea on four sides; within it is Wuzhi Mountain, where the Li people dwell.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "Qiongzhou is encircled by the sea on all sides. At its center stands Wuzhi Mountain, home to the Li people.

sentences.zh: 請設義學，俾子弟就學應試，別編'黎'字，州縣額取一名。」

translations.literal: I ask to establish charity schools so that sons and younger brothers may study and sit for examinations, with a separate register marked by the character 'Li,' and each prefecture and county to take one quota place."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that charity schools be established so Li youths may study and sit for the examinations, with a separate register marked by the character Li and one quota place allotted per prefecture and county."

sentences.zh: 八年，又疏言：「廣西東蘭州自雍正初改土為流，置兵二百戍守。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he again memorialized: "Since the early Yongzheng period Guangxi's Donglan Prefecture was converted from native to regular administration and two hundred troops were stationed to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he wrote again: "Guangxi's Donglan Prefecture was converted from native to regular rule in the early Yongzheng reign, with two hundred troops posted as a garrison.

sentences.zh: 水土毒惡，山路崎嶇，民病於運糧。

translations.literal: The water and soil are poisonous and harsh, the mountain roads rugged, and the people suffer from transporting grain.
translations.idiomatic: The land and water are harsh, the mountain roads tortuous, and the people are worn down by grain transport.

sentences.zh: 請以其半改駐三旺。」

translations.literal: I ask that half of them be transferred to garrison at Sanwang."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that half the garrison be redeployed to Sanwang."

sentences.zh: 均從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 复移督川、陝。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to govern Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to the Sichuan-Shaanxi governorship.

sentences.zh: 郭羅剋土番處青海界上，地寒不能畜牧，屢出為「夾壩」，夾壩，華言盜也。

translations.literal: The Guoluo Ke tribal people lay on the Qinghai border; the land was cold and could not support herding, and they repeatedly came out as "jiaba"—jiaba, in Chinese speech, means thief.
translations.idiomatic: The Guoluo Ke tribesmen lived on the Qinghai frontier. The country was too cold for herding, and they repeatedly raided as jiaba—jiaba being their word for bandit.

sentences.zh: 慶復令捕其酋林噶架立誅之，番眾頂經誓奉約束。

translations.literal: Qing Fu ordered the capture of their chief Lin Gajiali and had him executed; the tribesmen swore oaths upon scripture to obey regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Fu had their chief Lin Gajiali captured and executed, after which the tribesmen swore upon scripture to abide by the rules.

sentences.zh: 慶復令貧番三百餘戶授地課耕，歲五六月許出獵，限一次，寨限十五人。

translations.literal: Qing Fu ordered more than three hundred poor tribal households to be granted land and taught to plow; in the fifth and sixth months of the year they were permitted to go hunting, limited to once, with each stockade limited to fifteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Fu granted land and taught farming to more than three hundred impoverished households. In the fifth and sixth months they might hunt once per year, with no more than fifteen men per stockade.

sentences.zh: 要隘設汛置兵，松潘鎮總兵歲出巡，駐阿壩。

translations.literal: At strategic passes he established garrisons and posted troops; the Songpan Brigade Commander made an annual patrol and stationed at Aba.
translations.idiomatic: Garrisons were posted at key passes, and the Songpan brigade commander conducted an annual inspection, basing himself at Aba.

sentences.zh: 番人訟不決，詣總兵剖晰。

translations.literal: When tribal lawsuits could not be settled, they went to the Brigade Commander for judgment.
translations.idiomatic: When tribal disputes could not be resolved locally, the parties appealed to the brigade commander for judgment.

sentences.zh: 上中下三部置土千戶一、土百戶二，種人為盜，責三土目捕治。

translations.literal: In the upper, middle, and lower three sections he established one native thousand-household chief and two native hundred-household chiefs; when tribesmen became thieves, the three native chiefs were charged to capture and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: In the upper, middle, and lower districts he appointed one native thousand-household chief and two hundred-household chiefs; when tribesmen turned to banditry, these three native officers were held responsible for capture and punishment.

sentences.zh: 疏聞，下軍機大臣議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was reported; it was referred to the Grand Council for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, it was sent to the Grand Council for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 又有瞻對土司在打箭爐邊外，處萬山中，恃險肆劫，掠及台站兵，有司捕治。
